body:
### Summary

For this minimal `pyproject.toml`:
```toml
[project]
name = "mre"
version = "0.1.0"
requires-python = ">=3.11"

[project.optional-dependencies]
a = ["idna==3.9"]
b = ["idna==3.10"]

[tool.uv]
conflicts = [[{ extra = "a" }, { extra = "b" }]]
```

These commands:
```bash
uv sync --quiet --extra a

echo "--- uv workspace metadata"
uv workspace metadata --preview-features workspace-metadata > /dev/null
echo "exit code: $?"

echo "--- uv check --extra a"
uv check --preview-features=check-command --extra a
echo "exit code: $?"
```

Produce:
```
--- uv workspace metadata
Resolved 3 packages in 1ms
error: Failed to inspect environment
  cause: Found conflicting extras `mre[a]` and `mre[b]` enabled simultaneously
exit code: 2
--- uv check --extra a
WARN No python files found under the given path(s)
warning[uv-metadata]: `uv workspace metadata` failed with `exit status: 2`
--> pyproject.toml:1:1
info: Failed to inspect environment
  cause: Found conflicting extras `mre[a]` and `mre[b]` enabled simultaneously

Found 1 diagnostic
exit code: 1
```

### Platform

Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64

### Version

uv 0.13.4

### Python version

_No response_
title: `uv workspace metadata` and `uv check` fail with conflicting extras
